report_label: NOT CLINICAL VALIDATION -- S1-OOD v3: hand-authored synthetic final safety benchmark for T3 v3 (R1-R5 with the v3 structural checks).
purpose: Fresh one-shot holdout measuring confident errors, correct abstentions and false rejections of the T1->T2->T3 extractor with T3 v3. Frozen; never used for tuning.

conventions.expected_grams: TOTAL grams per herb as written; never inferred from frequency, duration or vague wording.
conventions.expected_herbs: Herbs a correct system emits. A clear correction counts as its final amount.
conventions.ood.spans: [text, type, occurrence, canonical]: token-aligned gold spans (T1 label set).
conventions.ood.abstain: [{herb, reason}]: emitting any of these is a confident error; not emitting it is a correct abstention.
conventions.safety.target_rules: R1..R5 the case exercises; 'control' = legitimate note that must not be rejected.
conventions.safety.unaccounted: [[amount text, occurrence]]: stated gram doses no output fact may use; R5 should warn.
conventions.dosha: Canonical set; an empty list means no dosha is stated.
